bluf: Work & Co is a Brooklyn digital product agency, founded in 2013, that builds apps, sites and commerce for enterprise brands and says it joined forces with Accenture Song in 2024 while still trading under its own name, site and client roster. Its direction on the record is AI: it sells GenAI builds, agentic workflows and AI accelerated delivery, credits a Gatorade generative AI bottle design and Pfizer Health Answers, and is hiring design leads in Lisbon. A rival should know that 19 of 20 named clients carry no described work in the needs read, and that a brand in transition is a book in play.
doing:
Work & Co positions as a digital product agency uniting product, design and engineering talent to transform clients' core businesses, now inside Accenture Song. Decoded: it designs and engineers the apps, websites and commerce platforms large companies run on, and since 2024 it does so under Accenture ownership, through Accenture Song. The headline claim credits it with IKEA's first ecommerce app and Today at Apple experiences, and says a Panera redesign lifted order conversion 16%.

The sold mix leads with Web & Product at score 3: its title and H1 sell a digital product agency, it lists builds for IKEA, Apple, Panera, Lyft and Pfizer, and it says half of its staff are engineers. AI Automation / Agents scores 2 and is core, on GenAI strategy, agentic AI workflows and AI accelerated delivery, with the Gatorade bottle design and Pfizer Health Answers as evidence. AI search, SEO, CRO, content, data, paid search, retail media and B2B each score 1 with no evidence note: marketing lines such as GEO & AI strategy and SEO & content strategy sit on a product core, and breadth reads 10. The proprietary layer is a trademarked approach, From Ambiguity to Impact, and an AI accelerated software delivery model. The record lists no partners.

AI posture: it sells AI accelerated delivery, GenAI product builds and agentic workflows, and publishes GEO tips and agentic commerce service design pieces.

Moves: one dated, the 2024 union with Accenture Song, per its company page. The jobs list shows six roles, product and design leads in Lisbon, PT and design roles across multiple US locations; Lisbon is not among its listed offices. Pricing: the record is silent. Conspicuously absent for a studio of its standing: ads of its own, a readable sitemap, a headcount and a partner list.
clients:
Work & Co sells to enterprise clients from offices in Brooklyn, Atlanta and Los Angeles, across verticals from airlines, sports and transportation to retail and fashion, financial services and real estate, and telecommunications.

The needs read holds 20 named clients, 16 by case study evidence and 4 by press release: 1 observed and 19 names only. The one observed row is JW Anderson, web build and platform, from the slug on its digital redesign. The rest are coded names only, their signal fields empty: IKEA, Gatorade, Apple, Aesop, PGA TOUR, Vistaprint, Epic Games, MTA, Lyft, Philz Coffee and ALDO on client pages; Pfizer, Celanese and Pandora in press releases; Disney, Panera, Obama Foundation, Chase and Mercedes-Benz on the clients index. Their need is inferred from the sold mix as web build and platform, and the agency's own words lean the same way: the headline credits IKEA's first ecommerce app, Today at Apple and a Panera redesign, the capability note credits Gatorade's generative AI bottle design and Pfizer Health Answers, slugs name Pandora's new digital flagship and Celanese launching Chemille, and prominence notes credit the Aesop site (named Best Website Design by Fast Company) and Obama.org (Red Dot Best of the Best).

Shared books: Apple also sits with pmg and jellyfish, Pfizer with moburst, Pandora with promodo.

What the base needs next: the Horus read places Work & Co best for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer). It is likely, moderate confidence, that clients who bought flagship apps and sites from it next need those products readable by answer engines and shopping agents; with no feed, schema or entity work in the record (P2 absent), a roughly even chance they buy that layer elsewhere.

market:

Best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation (net 0.202, AI Search / GEO and Content & Digital PR against SEO), and KJ4, the platforms are absorbing the execution layer (net 0.202, Data & Measurement and AI Automation against Paid Search). No judgment reads as a headwind. Best scenario fit: The Bazaar of Agents at 46/100. It makes no P move in full: partial on P1 and P6, absent on P2, P7 and P8, unknown on P5; P3 and P4 do not apply. Its graveyard flag marks agentic language in its own sales copy.

openings:
The strongest opening is the transition. Work & Co says it joined forces with Accenture Song in 2024 yet still trades under its own name, and 19 of its 20 named clients are names only, from IKEA and Apple to Chase and Mercedes-Benz. Clients in a transition answer the phone: it is likely, moderate confidence, that a rival offering an independent senior product team wins meetings with accounts whose agency now answers to a consultancy owner. Falsifier: new dated Work & Co launches with these clients after 2024, showing the book held.

Apple is the shopper, also on the books of pmg and jellyfish; Pfizer sits with moburst and Pandora with promodo, each a roughly even chance of being in play.

The machine readable layer is unclaimed: no feed, schema or entity work in the record (P2 absent) on a core web line, so an offer that makes its clients' products legible to answer engines and agents is likely to undercut it under KJ1 and KJ4. It sells paid search with no ads of its own and no test of ads inside assistants (P8 absent), and shows no public pricing model (P5 unknown).
